name: balajiinfra-firebase-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions (2nd gen) for the tenant Firebase Auth project. Currently just the beforeSignIn blocking function that sets the role: "authenticated" custom claim Supabase's third-party Firebase auth integration requires (see CLAUDE.md §4 rule 14).

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions:beforeSignIn
